items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I remember having seen Toodle-oo around Pittsburgh working in some little club but he would be one of the musicians I met at the Crawford Grill or at the musician's club.

ctx.x: so well known ones which I have taken from the book of There was a Boogie Woogie piano player. Nobody is quite sure what his first name was, but one possibility is that it was Toodle-oo.

I remember having seen Toodle-oo around Pittsburgh working in some little club but he would be one of the musicians I met at the Crawford Grill or at the musician's club. And the other one was "Dry Bread". Yeah, I remember him. And I remember "Dry Bread". And there were other entertainers around Pittsburgh too that were lined up at the Crawford Grill.
Did you hear them play ever?
